design.temperature_wave: A*(sin(2*pi*t/P+phi)-sin(phi)) in the initial-isotherm coordinate frame; initial error comparable
design.radial_scope: Physical mean radius fixed5mm; initialize at R_mean-A*sin(phi)/gradient. Mean field and entire radius range stay fixed.
design.linear_scope: Translated initial-isotherm coordinates; physical start position shifts by -A*sin(phi)/gradient along field normal.
design.discarded_design: First anchored fixed-initial-radius design stopped: A=.1K phi=3pi/2 would collapse the target to origin; retained separately, excluded.
design.late_scope: Late interval is a startup diagnostic, not a steady-state claim.
